input_messages.content: Hey there! So, I got a bit of a situation—I ordered a tablet, but somehow I ended up with two. I only need one, and I want to send back the pricier one and get my money back on my credit card. Can you help me sort this out?
Oh, I totally blanked on the email I used—sorry! But my name’s Chen Silva and my zip code is 46281. Will that work?

Oh, I’m not sure about the order number off the top of my head, but I can tell you one of the tablets is a Galaxy Tab S9 Ultra, and the other is a regular Galaxy Tab S9. The Ultra is the more expensive one, so that’s the one I want to send back. Does that help?

Hmm, actually, I want to return the more expensive one, but I want the refund to go back to my credit card. If that’s not possible—like, if you can only refund to a gift card or something—then I’d rather just send both tablets back and get everything refunded to a gift card instead. Can you do the refund to my credit card for the pricier one?

Wait, so you can’t refund the more expensive one to my credit card? That’s super annoying! Honestly, if I can’t get the refund to my card, I just want to send both tablets back and get everything refunded to a gift card. Can you set that up for me?
Yes, that’s exactly what I want—return both tablets and get the whole refund on my gift card. Go ahead and set it up!

Awesome, thanks for helping me out! I’ll keep an eye out for those emails. That’s all I needed. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
